preview.tournamentOverview: Albany GC rewards balanced ball-striking and short-game control over pure distance. SG Total, SG Around-the-Green, and SG Off-the-Tee carry the heaviest course weights, while SG Approach and putting play smaller roles. The limited field and elevated purse make this a high-leverage spot for model-driven bets.
preview.modelExplainer: SG Total 7%) and SG Around-the-Green 6%) dominate the model, followed closely by SG Off-the-Tee 5%). SG Putting 1%) and SG Approach 7%) are secondary, while Driving Accuracy and Bogey Avoidance each sit at 0%. The model therefore prioritizes players who gain strokes broadly and scramble well.
preview.pickApproach: We tier bets by combining tournamentRank and powerRank gaps. Top-tier targets show both high model rank and strong SG Total; secondary bets chase positive regression in key weighted stats. Exposure scales with rank differential and course-fit strength.

article.title: Hero World Challenge 2026: Model Ranks Scheffler, Fitzpatrick, Young, Bridgeman Highest at Albany
article.dek: Four players with top-5 model ranks and zero tracked major-swing rounds lead the 20-player field.
article.introduction: The Hero World Challenge model ranks Scottie Scheffler #1, Matt Fitzpatrick #2, Cameron Young #3, and Jacob Bridgeman #5. All four players carry the same post-Open research classification of zero tracked major-swing rounds and skipped Scottish Open.

sections.heading: Tournament Overview

sections.heading: Course Fit
